description: The woman wears an opaque dark forest-green floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Muted gold-brown knotwork borders trace the neckline, bodice edges, cuffs, front panels and hem. A decorated belt has a round knotwork clasp and a long patterned fringed end. A cream underdress shows between the front panels. A green-brown patterned wool shawl rests over the shoulders, secured by two small round brooches, and falls down the sides with fringed edges. Small earrings and a ring are visible, along with brown leather shoes beneath the hem.
